admission.justification: Spans both note routes (overwrite/append): neither may change tool grants or settings authority, which is the authority-preservation half of FAM-N17BB4's launch guarantee; plain-text composition is the enforced mechanism.

applicability: Every composition of role instruction text for a launch.
conditions: At most the first nonempty overwrite tag selects the overwrite route.
exclusions: Tool grants and settings authority, which neither text route changes.
The structural capsule and assignment outside the host instruction block.
statement: Role notes remain plain text: the first nonempty overwrite tag replaces only the host instruction block, append remains the default, and neither text route changes tool grants or settings authority.
